capabilities: Generate Anki flashcards from the current note using the DeepSeek API
Recognize images in notes when generating cards
Create Cloze cards with automatic {{c::}} formatting and an incremental fill-in button
Batch-replace tags across all generated cards
Copy generated card content for import into Anki and test the Anki Connect connection
extras: README is written in Chinese. Requires an internet connection; note content is sent to the DeepSeek API for processing, and API calls may incur costs. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: 在ankify基础上增加的扩展功能
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn note content into Anki flashcards, so users must write cards by hand or paste notes into other tools.
